curation.notes: Stall force of human KIF1A (WT, KAND mutants P305L, V8M, A255V, and mutant/WT heterodimers) measured with a Cy3-labelled DNA origami nanospring (NS) linking KIF1A to an inert KIF5B(G234A) anchor on surface-bound microtubules; force is read out from NS extension in fluorescence images via a pre-calibrated force-extension curve. No optical tweezers were used in this study (auto record wrongly assigned dual-trap OT); stall force values are only in figures, not in the provided text.

evidence.snippet: The flow chamber was maintained at 25°C using a heating plate (HP-R-Z002, Live Cell Instrument) during observation.

was recorded at 33 frames per second (fps) with an effective pixel size of 65 nm by a CMOS camera (ORCA-Flash4.0, Hamamatsu Photonics). Experiments were also performed at 100 fps in addition to the recording rate of 33 fps

entities.name: KIF1A(1–393)-LZ-SNAP-6His (kinesin-3 motor domain dimer)
entities.region: residues 1–393 fused to GCN4 leucine zipper and SNAP-tag

evidence.snippet: A recombinant human KIF1A(1–393)-LZ-SNAP-6His construct containing the motor domain (amino acids 1–361), neck linker, neck coil domain, and a GCN4 leucine zipper (LZ) for stabilized dimerization was used for NS force generated study
A recombinant human KIF1A(1–393)-LZ-SNAP-Strep-tagII construct was used to develop heterodimers of wild-type and mutant KIF1A.

Inactive mutant kinesin 5 B (G234A) expression vector was a gift from Dr. Yuta Shimamoto (National Institute of Genetics), which has been described (pYS05 K560 pET-17b KIF5B (1–560, G234A)::LZ::His-tag)

entities.name: DNA origami nanospring (four-helix bundle coil, Cy3-labelled)

evidence.snippet: NSs were designed by introducing a negative superhelical strain into a four-helix bundle arranged on a square lattice.
Tubulin was purified from porcine brain (Tokyo Shibaura Organ Co, Ltd) through two cycles of polymerization and depolymerization
a total of 116 Cy3 molecules were conjugated to the DNA calibration rod at equal intervals
